paper.title: GDPval: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Real-World Economically Valuable Tasks

evidence_ledger.exact_claim_text: Section 2는 Bureau of Labor Statistics work activity와 GDP contribution을 이용해 sector와 occupation을 고른다.
full set은 44개 occupation마다 최소 30 task를 두고, 공개 gold subset은 occupation당 5개로 총 220 task다.
primary metric은 model과 industry expert deliverable에 대한 head-to-head human preference다.
automated grader는 rough estimate이며 pairwise expert grading의 대체물이 아니다.
OpenAI official article, hosted PDF, evals portal이 동일 benchmark를 게시하고 저자 소속을 OpenAI로 명시한다.
Section 3.1의 headline comparison에서 Claude Opus 4.1 deliverable의 47.6%가 human expert deliverable보다 좋거나 동등하다고 평가됐다.
GDPval의 강점은 평가 단위를 시험 정답에서 usable deliverable로 바꾼 데 있다.
evidence_ledger.source_anchor: Task construction Section 2 and pairwise grading Section 2.5; direct reviewer inference
evidence_ledger.notes: Interpretation of the benchmark unit, not a measured outcome.

method_map.role: compare complex model and expert outputs
method_map.assumption: grader expertise and rubric yield valid comparisons

method_map.input: model runs with varied inference support
method_map.assumption: interventions are comparable within the reported setup

result_table.result_claim: full set은 44개 occupation마다 최소 30 task를 두고, 공개 gold subset은 occupation당 5개로 총 220 task다.
result_table.setup: GDPval dataset across 9 sectors; tasks based on professionals with average 14 years experience
result_table.exact_value: 44 occupations; ≥30 full tasks each; 5 gold each; 220 gold total

result_table.result_claim: primary metric은 model과 industry expert deliverable에 대한 head-to-head human preference다.
Section 3.1의 headline comparison에서 Claude Opus 4.1 deliverable의 47.6%가 human expert deliverable보다 좋거나 동등하다고 평가됐다.
result_table.setup: GDPval gold subset blind pairwise grading
result_table.comparator: Claude Opus 4.1 versus human expert deliverable
result_table.caveat: Model style may partially reveal identity; gold-subset result.

critique_log.critique: Task capability is not an occupation automation rate.
critique_log.label: direct inference from setup

critique_log.critique: Treat deliverable-level realism as a benchmark-design strength, not proof of labor-market validity.
critique_log.label: direct inference from setup
critique_log.reason: External validity depends on sampling and grading.
